scopeDescription: docs-only residual-gate and master-plan reconciliation after OPS-207 staging merge

residuals.nextAction: Collect a comparable pre/post cohort with non-zero rerun denominators and a first-actionable-failure sample.
residuals.stopCondition: Keep affected profiles observational until the follow-up passes or records a new evidence-backed revise decision.

residuals.nextAction: Track the measurable follow-up without treating the decision as a KPI pass.
residuals.stopCondition: Do not mark the original optimization target passed while the comparable cohort is missing.

residuals.nextAction: Do not pursue the upstream updater in this initiative; keep the consumer pinned to harness-v0.1.8 and run only the product/release proof.
residuals.stopCondition: No fork or local patch; any future updater adoption requires a separately authorized initiative and a tagged upstream fix.

residuals.nextAction: Approve the cutover topology, HTTP/WebSocket drain, migration compatibility, rollback, and Home SLO/parity contract before staging mutation.
residuals.stopCondition: No zero-downtime or load claim without approved authority, observability, cleanup, and rollback evidence.

residuals.nextAction: Keep product/design route and media decisions in a separately scoped initiative.
residuals.stopCondition: Do not expand the Phase 0–10 checklist without new product authority.

residuals.nextAction: Keep realtime/collaboration architecture runway separately scoped.
residuals.stopCondition: Preserve current API/session/realtime behavior until a bounded contract exists.

residuals.nextAction: Keep additional verification guardrails as a separate backlog bundle.
residuals.stopCondition: Do not weaken the current fail-closed runner contract to absorb backlog scope.

nextAction: Run the exact final Phase 10 product/release ladder and authenticated staging smoke; the upstream updater is an explicit owner-approved exception and is not a release prerequisite.

upstreamException.reason: No tagged upstream conflict-exit-range fix exists; the consumer remains pinned to harness-v0.1.8, and status/doctor are healthy while update --dry-run is blocked without source mutation.
upstreamException.productionUse: The release workflow does not invoke the Harness updater; no fork or local patch is introduced.
upstreamException.followUp: None in OPS-64; any future updater adoption requires a separately authorized initiative.

rollback: One squash revert; docs/evidence only; no runtime, dependency, archive, Harness DB, staging mutation or production promotion.
